articles.title: Hidalgo: “Estamos haciendo cosas bien pero no nos llega”
articles.standfirst: El técnico reconoce resignado que los errores le están penalizando mucho
articles.summary: El técnico reconoce resignado que los errores le están penalizando mucho
articles.body: El Dépor firmó una gran media hora inicial tuteando a todo un Atlético de Madrid. Con Yeremay liderando el ataque y Giménez la defensa. Apenas el Atlético puso en peligro al conjunto gallego. “Jugamos intensos y llevamos el plan de partido muy bien”. En la segunda los locales estuvieron mejor aunque el Depor acabó el partido con una ocasión clara. “Esto va de ganar partidos, estamos haciendo cosas bien pero no nos llega, hay que hacer más cosas bien”. El Dépor compitió durante los noventa minutos frente a todo un equipo Champions. “Los equipos te compiten son rachas y queremos sumar de tres en tres, hemos realizado un buen partidos y estuvimos cerca de sumar”. El técnico catalán expuso que en Primera división los errores en ambas áreas te penalizan. “El fin de semana pasado fallamos una ocasión muy clara en esta ocasión hemos fallado otra, son jugadores jóvenes que deben crecer también con estos errores”.

images.caption: Antonio Hidalgo, durante el partido ante el Atlético de Madrid MARCA

articles.title: Aeroporto de Porto Alegre tem voo para Recife atrasado e 2 cancelados | G1
articles.standfirst: No sábado (24), voo de Porto Alegre para Salvador foi cancelado e causou tumulto no aeroporto. Todos os passageiros foram realocados e conseguiram chegar à cidade baiana.
articles.summary: No sábado (24), voo de Porto Alegre para Salvador foi cancelado e causou tumulto no aeroporto. Todos os passageiros foram realocados e conseguiram chegar à cidade baiana.
articles.body:
Aeroporto de Porto Alegre — Foto: Agência RBS

Dois voos que sairiam de Porto Alegre com destino ao aeroporto de Guarulhos , em São Paulo , foram cancelados na manhã deste domingo (25) no Aeroporto Salgado Filho.

Os voos cancelados são o AD2854 , da companhia aérea Azul, que tinha saída prevista para as 8h35, e o voo LA3427 , da Latam, que sairia às 3h30.

Além dos dois cancelamentos, o aeroporto de Porto Alegre registrou atraso em um voo para Recife . O voo AD4151 , da Azul, que sairia às 7h, foi reagendado para as 10h.

No sábado, houve tumulto no aeroporto de Porto Alegre por conta do cancelamento de um voo para Salvador . De acordo com a companhia aérea Gol, todos os passageiros foram reacomodados e concluíram a viagem entre o sábado e o domingo. Saiba mais abaixo .

Um voo da Gol que sairia de Porto Alegre com destino a Salvador foi cancelado neste sábado (24) e gerou protesto entre passageiros.

Entre os viajantes estava a administradora Diandra Santos, de 37 anos, que seguia para Maceió. Foi ela quem realizou a gravação. Assista acima .

Ao g1, a Gol informou que a aeronave que faria o voo G3 1979, entre Porto Alegre e Salvador, apresentou problemas técnicos, o que levou ao cancelamento da operação.

De acordo com a companhia, "os clientes receberam atendimento e foram reacomodados em outros voos da empresa, com opções de embarque ainda neste sábado ou no domingo."

Ainda segundo a companhia, além da reacomodação dos passageiros em outros voos, foi criado um "voo reforço", que pousou em Salvador na manhã deste domingo.

articles.title: Yahoo Top 10: BYU's stunning upset loss shakes up college football picture
articles.summary: The toast of college football one week is the sport's disappointment the next.
articles.body:
The toast of college football one week is the sport's disappointment the next.

BYU became the 10th team in the top 15 over the last two weeks to lose. Sure, some of those were against other top-15 programs. But that wasn't the case for many of them, including the Cougars' 39-31, double-overtime defeat at the hands of UCF on Saturday.

The loss tumbles BYU down our Top 10, from second to seventh. Tennessee, meanwhile, fell out entirely after losing against South Carolina , and Texas Tech's loss at Cincinnati sent the Red Raiders to a quick exit from the poll. The Red Raiders' loss, combined with BYU losing, means the Big 12's two most hopeful preseason playoff teams fell on the same day.

In the SEC, Texas and Arch Manning, reeling after two straight losses, hung on to beat Ole Miss and send the Rebels out of the rankings, too.

After an upset-filled Week 7 — five of the top seven ranked teams lost — college football delivered again this Saturday.

Some people even lost their jobs. NC State, after a Friday night loss to Stanford, fired coach Dave Doeren , ending his 14-year tenure with the program. Meanwhile, Indiana remained in our rankings after surviving a trip to the Big House , and UCLA moved to 7-0 by beating Michigan State.

The safest Top 10 teams on Saturday were Ohio State, Georgia and Notre Dame, which all had an off week!

The Buckeyes had a well-earned off week after beating Indiana and losing quarterback Julian Sayin in the process. Sayin is out indefinitely with a shoulder injury that may linger through even the postseason. This doesn't bode well for things down the stretch as Ohio State is left with two unproven backups, freshman Luke Fahey and sophomore Tavien St. Clair. They'll compete in an unusual midseason QB battle.

If you thought the Hurricanes would get distracted from their first AP No. 1 ranking since 2002, think again! Receiver Malachi Toney broke the school's single-game record for receptions with 16. He had 194 yards and three touchdowns too as QB Darian Mensah and crew carved through a Panthers team badly missing their starting quarterback.

QB Josh Hoover isn't fully healthy, something coach Curt Cignetti mentioned in his post-game, on-camera interview. But the Hoosiers found a way to win in the Big House in overtime. However was 8-for-18 and threw his first interceptions of the season. IU needed to lean on a salty defensive effort to survive, including keeping Michigan out of the end zone on three snaps inside the 10 to force a field goal and overtime.

The Bruins are looking down the barrel of being 8-0 in Bob Chesney's first season as coach, with Nevada on deck. Backup QB Ty Dieffenbach continues to fill in for injured starter Nico Iamaleava (out for the season). He doesn't have to be a world-beater with this team. The Bruins play great defense and can run the ball. RB Anthony Woods had more than 100 yards and three Bruins had rushing scores.

Kirby Smart would have probably liked nothing more than to rebound from the shocking home loss to Auburn by whipping an opponent the very next Saturday. But the Bulldogs got a break and return to action in what's turned into a really important game against the Gators at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. Florida is fresh off an upset at Texas. This annual rivalry series, normally played in Jacksonville, moved to Atlanta while renovations are made to EverBank Stadium.

How to follow a rousing victory over a top-five team? Lay an egg while on a cross-country trip. That's what the Cougars did. UCF's Keyone Jenkins, not Bear Bachmeier, stole this show, throwing for 293 yards and three touchdowns against a BYU defense that entered the game ranked 12th in the country. BYU's offense couldn't find its normal running ability either.

If I told you before the season that Kentucky would be not only in the Top 10 but leading the SEC, you'd be pretty shocked, no? But the Wildcats, under first-year coach Will Stein, are 7-1 and atop the league. On Saturday, they stormed back from a 10-0 hole and if you wondered how, here's a stunning stat: Vanderbilt had 15 yards rushing. The Cats are for real and they get a bye before a whopper of a game at Tennessee.

Sure, the Irish faltered at BYU last week but they're still plenty good to be in the Top 10 (we think). Before hosting Miami in one of the most anticipated matchups of the 2026 season on Nov. 7, Marcus Freeman's team needs to take care of business against Navy at the New England Patriots' stadium. Miami and SMU loom down the stretch as key games if the Irish want to make the playoff.

The Utes are one of just three unbeaten teams in college football after surviving at home against a pesky Houston team. QB Devon Dampier ran for more than 100 yards and threw for more than 200. He helped erase his two interceptions by leading Utah on a 10-play, 80-yard fourth-quarter touchdown drive to take the lead. The Utes' defense helped ice it in the end.

Are the Demon Deacons the second-best team in the ACC under first-year coach Jake Dickert? They challenged Miami (few have done that this year) and won at Purdue (that performance looks better and better). QB Gio Lopez has run for at least 50 yards and thrown for at least 250 yards in two of the last three games. He's got 14 touchdowns (four rushing) in the last four games and hasn't thrown a pick over that stretch.

images.caption: BYU tight end Walker Lyons, left, looks on as UCF players celebrate after the final play of the second overtime. (AP Photo/Phelan M. Ebenhack)
UCLA head coach Bob Chesney and the Bruins are still undefeated through Week 8. (Allen J. Schaben via Getty Images)

articles.title: Neymar sent off for breaking ‘Vini Jr. rule’ after mouth-covering exchange, opponent claims disrespect, Santos star fires back in furious rant
articles.summary: Neymar was sent off for covering his mouth during a confrontation with Rodrigo Nestor, who accused him of disrespect, igniting a heated debate over the application of anti-racism measures in football.
articles.body: Neymar was sent off in Santos’ 1-1 draw with Bahia after covering his mouth during a heated exchange with Rodrigo Nestor, prompting a VAR review and a straight red card under the so-called “Vini Jr. rule”. The Brazilian forward later admitted he had made a mistake but fiercely accused his opponent of exploiting an anti-racism measure to gain an advantage, launching an angry attack on the Bahia midfielder on social media.The incident unfolded before the second half began on Saturday, October 24, with Santos trailing 1-0. It followed an earlier confrontation between the pair and a half-time television interview in which Nestor accused Neymar of disrespecting him and Bahia. Santos eventually rescued a 1-1 draw, but the controversy surrounding their captain quickly overshadowed the result.Why Neymar was shown a straight red cardThe tension between Neymar and Nestor had been building throughout the first half. After a foul, Neymar threw the ball towards the Bahia midfielder, prompting a confrontation involving players from both sides. Neymar received a yellow card for his part in the incident.The dispute continued during the interval. As the teams gathered near the centre circle ahead of the restart, Neymar approached Nestor and appeared to exchange words with him. After initially laughing, the Santos forward returned to the conversation with his hand covering his mouth.Nestor immediately alerted the referee, Sávio Pereira Sampaio. Following a review of the footage at the pitchside monitor, the official showed Neymar a straight red card before the second half could begin. The decision was made under the rule commonly referred to as the “Vini Jr. rule”, which targets players who cover their mouths while allegedly directing abusive or discriminatory remarks at opponents.The measure is intended to help officials address abuse that might otherwise be concealed from cameras and spectators. Covering one's mouth alone does not establish what was said, but in this incident the referee acted after reviewing the footage and applying the relevant rule.Neymar reacted furiously to the dismissal. The confrontation continued as he left the field, with players and staff from both teams becoming involved in the ensuing commotion. Reports also described Neymar moving towards Nestor before others intervened.What Rodrigo Nestor said about NeymarNestor had already explained his side of the dispute during a half-time interview with Brazilian broadcaster SporTV. He accused Neymar of making disrespectful remarks and said he would not repeat them publicly."My parents raised me well, I'm very grateful to them," he said, as reported by Marca. "And I know perfectly well where I come from. I was born in Itaquera; it was difficult to get where I am today, and I'm proud to wear the Bahia jersey."He knows what he said to me. It was disrespectful to me and to the Bahia jersey. He's an idol to everyone as a player, but today he failed as a person because of the way he spoke. You shouldn't do those kinds of things. My parents raised me very well, and I'm grateful for the upbringing they gave me. I would never say something like that."Nestor declined to disclose the precise words he claimed Neymar had used, explaining that children were watching the broadcast. Neymar, however, would later dispute Nestor's account of what happened during their exchange.Neymar apologises to Santos fans before launching angry attackAfter the match, Neymar addressed the controversy in a series of Instagram Stories. He apologised to Santos supporters and congratulated his team for fighting back to earn a draw, but he also questioned the use of the rule and accused Nestor of acting dishonestly.Neymar admitted that covering his mouth had been a mistake, while maintaining that he had not said anything to warrant the dismissal."What Nestor did to me today is very serious. Serious because this is a rule created to combat racism. He tried to gain an advantage in the game because I put my hand over my mouth, and I didn't even say anything to him. Obviously, we were trading insults, taking digs at each other, and that's fine, it's part of football."He continued: "But what he did is very serious. I was in midfield, we were joking around and arguing, I was joking with the two center-backs, and he used that to gain an advantage in the game. If this is a rule created to combat racism, how can he do these things? It's surreal."Neymar then accused Nestor of deliberately misrepresenting the exchange."I'm really upset about what happened because he was so underhanded. Really, really underhanded. I saw an interview where he said I'd insulted him, that he couldn't repeat it because there were kids watching. Man, he faked it. I threw the ball at his waist, and he put his hand to his face. And what kind of example does he think he's setting?"He also acknowledged his own role in the incident before directing another insult at his opponent."I had the chance to do that, but I'm a man*. I f...ed up, right? I gave an idiot a chance to make a name for himself, but that's fine. Now, Nestor, at least I'll sleep with a clear conscience. You, with your dirty tricks, you won't. Because this rule is meant to combat racism, not for you to use to your advantage."Neymar's response made clear how strongly he objected to the decision, but his accusation that Nestor had faked the incident remains his own claim. The controversy also has consequences beyond the match: Neymar will miss Santos' next fixtures against Palmeiras and Red Bull Bragantino, having already incurred a suspension through his yellow-card accumulation before receiving the red.The episode leaves a difficult question for football officials: how can rules designed to expose and deter discriminatory abuse be enforced fairly when the words exchanged between players cannot readily be heard? In Neymar's case, the referee's decision was clear. The competing accounts of what was said, however, remain at the heart of the controversy.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Números que hunden y números que animan
articles.standfirst: El Málaga todavía tiene cifras en las que creer
articles.summary: El Málaga todavía tiene cifras en las que creer
articles.body: El Málaga CF sigue sin encontrar la victoria en su regreso a Primera División, pero la situación clasificatoria todavía deja una puerta abierta a la esperanza. El empate del pasado viernes en Mendizorroza permitió al conjunto de Juanfran Funes alcanzar las diez primeras jornadas sin ganar, una circunstancia que no es inédita en la máxima categoría. De hecho, el Málaga se ha convertido en el vigésimo cuarto equipo de la historia de LaLiga que no consigue ganar ninguno de sus diez primeros partidos. Y los precedentes, aunque poco alentadores, tampoco condenan necesariamente al descenso. Ocho de los 23 conjuntos anteriores lograron terminar la temporada fuera de las posiciones de peligro, lo que supone aproximadamente un 35% de los casos. Entre quienes consiguieron darle la vuelta a un comienzo semejante aparecen el Murcia (1945-46), Valencia (1957-58), Valladolid (1982-83), Sabadell (1986-87), Osasuna (2008-09), Almería (2013-14) y Getafe (2021-22). A esa lista hay que añadir un recuerdo especialmente cercano: el del CD Málaga de la temporada 1967-68. Aquel equipo tampoco arrancó con buen pie. Perdió en el campo del Atlético de Madrid (2-0) y tuvo que esperar hasta su estreno en La Rosaleda para sumar su primer punto, un empate ante el Deportivo (1-1). Después llegó otra derrota contundente frente al Real Madrid (4-0), aunque el conjunto malagueño reaccionó con dos empates consecutivos ante Levante (0-0) y Celta (1-1). La mejoría, sin embargo, se frenó con las derrotas frente al Villarreal (1-3) y el Getafe (1-0). Tras el parón, el equipo volvió a sumar en casa gracias a un tanto de Niño en el último minuto, pero tampoco logró despegar. El empate contra el Espanyol (1-1) dio paso a una nueva derrota, esta vez especialmente dolorosa, ante la Real Sociedad (2-5). El Málaga actual ha vivido un guion parecido en las últimas semanas. El equipo de Funes ha competido y ha tenido partidos en los que estuvo cerca de sumar los tres puntos, pero continúa sin estrenarse. El viernes, en Vitoria, Aitor Mañas igualó en los últimos minutos un encuentro que los blanquiazules tenían prácticamente ganado, dejando al Málaga con cinco puntos después de diez jornadas.

articles.title: Ángel Torres: “Somos una familia y las familias también se enfadan”
articles.standfirst: El presidente azulón habló en la previa del duelo en San Mamés
articles.summary: El presidente azulón habló en la previa del duelo en San Mamés
articles.body: El presidente del Getafe, Ángel Torres, habló en los micrófonos de DAZN en la previa del duelo frente al Athletic Club. El mandatario azulón cerró cualqueir polémcia tars la derrota frente al Lugano con Bordlaás y dejó claro que el objetivo del equipo es sumar para salir del atolladero. Reunión con Bordalás: “Como todo el mundo dice, Getafe es una familia y en las familias suelen pasar estas cosas. Algunas veces se nos va la olla, a mí el primero, pero no pasa nada. Hay que confiar en el entrenador, jugadores y el gran estadio que estamos haciendo. No le daría más importancia”. Problema del equipo: “Me preocupo bastante poco, veo lo que ha ocurrido, hablamos los dos y luego fui al entrenamiento a ver a los chavales, que es lo que más me preocupa, que nadie se sienta afectado y perjudicado. No tiene más importancia. Somos una familia y lo somos para todo, y en las familias también se enfadan”. Mercado: “Las lesiones nos han matado, sobre todo la de Uche, y no somos capaces de encontrar. Estamos viendo qué hay en el mercado y, si encontramos algo que mejore, que no es fácil, traeremos algo y, si no, esperaremos a enero. Tenemos que recuperar en Europa el patinazo, se puso todo el mundo nervioso porque no estamos acostumbrados a que nos metan cinco en casa, pero hay que acostumbrarse a perder”.

images.caption: Ángel Torres, en las instalaciones del Getafe. SERGIO ENRÍQUEZ

articles.title: El Sabadell se estrella con el larguero y le empata el Tenerife
articles.standfirst: Los arlequinados tuvieron más ocasiones en un duelo de recién ascendidos resuelto con dos cabezazos de Óscar Sanz y Enric Gallego
articles.summary: El Sabadell tuvo más ocasiones pero se estrella con el palo y empata contra el Tenerife
articles.body: El Sabadell no pudo pasar del empate contra el Tenerife en el duelo de la Nova Creu Alta entre dos recién ascendidos y en el que tuvo dos disparos francos al larguero. Se adelantó con un cabezazo de Óscar Sanz, pero Enric Gallego, también de cabeza, frustró una nueva alegría arlequinada. El equipo de Ferran Costa sigue invicto en un estadio que hace dos años acogía partidos de Segunda RFEF. El cuadro de Álvaro Cervera, con cinco caras nuevas en el once, enlazó su sexta jornada sin ganar, desde un 13 de septiembre cada vez más lejano. El Sabadell quería pasar página de la derrota contra el Burgos en su peor partido de la temporada y pronto tuvo una triple ocasión clarísima para adelantarse en el electrónico, en un saque de esquina antes del cuarto de hora: primero Bonaldo hizo temblar el larguero, luego un defensa repelió el cabezazo de Gastón Valles sobre la línea de gol de forma providencial y finalmente Dani Martín desvió a córner un disparo con mucha intención desde lejos de López-Pinto. La afición de la Nova Creu Alta no podía creerse que la acción no hubiera acabado en gol. Y poco antes de la pausa volvió a tener la misma sensación, tan frustrante: Gastón Valles, solo en el corazón del área pequeña, tenía toda la portería delante, pero estrelló su chut en el travesaño. El Sabadell no había encontrado el premio en la primera mitad, pero lo halló nada más comenzar la segunda mitad. Óscar Sanz, jugador clave, inauguró el electrónico con un potente cabezazo en una falta lateral sacada por Ton Ripoll. El encuentro parecía decantarse a favor del bando catalán, pero el Tenerife conquistó el 1-1 definitivo ocho minutos después: Nacho Gil centró al área y ahí apareció Enric Gallego para imponer su ley y restablecer el equilibrio con un cabezazo ajustado al palo izquierdo de Fuoli, inalcanzable. El Sabadell se levantó rápidamente del suelo y siguió buscando el gol de la victoria, pero volvió a faltarle puntería, como en un potente disparo de Catalá que salió rozando el larguero. Al final, una falta directa de Dani Fernández se marchó cerca del poste y el empate ya no se movió del marcador.

articles.title: El Athletic vuelve a zurrar al Getafe
articles.standfirst: Clara victoria de los de Terzic, que con el partido decidido hizo debutar a Imga y Vizcay
articles.summary: Clara victoria de los de Terzic, que con el partido decidido hizo debutar a Imga y Vizcay
articles.body: En un domingo de clásico el mediodía se intenta disfrutar también a partir de un Athletic-Getafe. Y en esta oportunidad el partido de San Mamés venía precedido de las dificultades en las vísperas de ambos equipos, que son las que habían convertido el cruce en más que un duelo por tres puntos. El Athletic llegaba después de cuatro partidos seguidos sin ganar y de una derrota descorazonadora frente al Levante y el Getafe tras caer con estrépito en su campo en Conference ante el Lugano, cita a la que siguió una impetuosa rajada de Bordalás. Unos y otros estaban más que advertidos de que en La Catedral no se repartirían caramelos y que lo que allí ocurriese tendría significado. Y pasó que el Athletic ganó con comodidad a un Getafe que con el partido ya cantado sufrió la expulsión de Mario Martín. Al instante de esa roja Yuri hizo el 4-0. El duelo tomó color rojiblanco en una primera mitad en la que el Getafe estuvo por aumentar las razones de queja que había mostrado Bordalás después de la dura derrota ante el Lugano. Berenguer, con una falta tirada a centrar que nadie fue capaz de sujetar, e Iñaki Williams, tras una carrera con Gudejl que los azulones protestaron por lo que consideraban una falta previa de Gerenabarrena en el inicio de la jugada, alegraron la sobremesa a Terzic. No ya por los dos goles, sino porque hasta entonces el Athletic había sido el que mejor había entrado a un partido al que el el Getafe le tocó encontrar las distancias. Los madrileños concedieron demasiado espacio pese a estar dibujados para todo lo contrario y luego, cuando se quisieron estirar, que es algo que se dio mientras hubo empate en el marcador, la voluntad defensiva de Nico y Rincón estuvo por encima de su argumento. La bordalina del descanso trajo dos relevos y un cambio de planteamiento en lo suyos, que estiraron el campo conscientes de que vivir como en la primera mitad sería firmar capitulaciones. Apretaron al Athletic de salida, pero los leones no acusaron el nerviosismo que querían trasladarles los azulones. El partido quedó para inventario cuando en el 70 un cabezazo de Paredes golpeó en Valou y se coló sin remisión en la portería de David Soria. Un resultado de contundencia para satisfacer a una afición que desde poco antes escrutaba a Imga, internacional juvenil al que Terzic decidió convertir en debutante después de haberle llevado a dos convocatorias anteriores. El alemán dio otro guiño más a los aficionados cuando a ocho minutos del final también decidió el debut del delantero del filial Txus Vizcay. El triunfo no fue del todo redondo por eso de que la asistencia fue la peor de la temporada. San Mamés ha perdido 5.000 aficionados desde el primer partido de Liga ante el Sevilla. Es la peor entrada en los últimos 24 partidos ligueros del Athletic en su campo.

articles.title: David Soria explota tras la semana negra del Getafe: "Somos anticompetitivos"
articles.standfirst: El capitán azulón criticó el papel de los azulones tras otra goleada ante el Athletic
articles.summary: El capitán azulón criticó el papel de los azulones tras otra goleada ante el Athletic
articles.body: El portero del Getafe, David Soria, comparecía al término del encuentro frente al Athletic Club. En una dura semana, con nueve goles encajados, el portero hizo autocrítica y aseveró que “el equipo es anticompetitivo” en estos momentos e instó a sus compañeros a “subir el nivel individual”. Valoración: “Estamos en un momento muy malo, en un momento en el que el equipo es anticompetitivo, la única solución es elevar el nivel personal de cada uno porque nadie está dando el nivel de Primera y en los resultados se está demostrando”. Por qué: “Cuando encajas nueve goles en dos partidos significa que no hay nada bien, empezando por mí y terminando por el último compañero. Solo queda elevar el nivel personal para que el grupal suba y estamos en octubre. Nosotros vemos, estamos a tiempo, hay que empezar a apretar”. Vestuario: “Estamos jodidos, el Getafe encaja nueve goles en dos partidos, eso no lo he visto en la vida. Estamos mal todos. Psicológicamente tocados, frágiles. No te queda otra que apretar. La clave es subir el nivel individual, nadie está dando su mejor versión”. Mario Martín: “No he conseguido verla, cuando todo va mal todo se ve en contra”.

articles.title: Pitada de San Mamés a Carvajal y abrazo final con Yuri para cerrar el episodio de 2023
articles.standfirst: El público rojiblanco no se cortó con el lateral del Getafe, cuya entrada acabó lesionando de gravedad al zurdo del Athletic en un partido disputado hace tres años
articles.summary: El público rojiblanco no se cortó con el lateral del Getafe, cuya entrada acabó lesionando de gravedad al zurdo del Athletic en un partido disputado hace tres años
articles.body: Desde incluso antes del inicio del encuentro en San Mamés entre Athletic y Getafe, el público de La Catedral la tuvo con Dani Carvajal. Muchos aficionados profirieron varios insultos al madrileño y, cada vez que cogía la pelota, se oían silbidos de forma muy destacada. Esto se debe a lo sucedido en 2023 en un partido entre Athletic y Real Madrid, también en Bilbao. En aquel duelo, una dura entrada del que fuera lateral madridista acabó lesionando a Yuri Berchiche, que sufrió una fractura de peroné. Un episodio que los aficionados rojiblancos no olvidaron... aunque parece que los futbolistas sí. Tras el duelo que se llevaron los de Terzic por 4-0 se pudo ver al final a ambos futbolistas charlando con una sonrisa en la cara y fundiéndose en un abrazo que parece enterrar definitivamente un episodio desgradable.

articles.title: How Cristiano Ronaldo can own two Saudi mansions worth $9 million without citizenship: Inside his unique Gifted Residency arrangement
articles.summary: Discover how Cristiano Ronaldo navigates Saudi Arabia's Gifted Residency program to own two luxurious mansions worth $9 million, breaking traditional residency laws for foreign nationals.
articles.body: When Cristiano Ronaldo descended upon Riyadh in January 2023, the footballing landscape shifted on its axis. Yet, the true legacy of his historic move to the Gulf may not be written in the goals he scores for Al-Nassr, but in the legal templates he is breaking. For decades, the Gulf kingdoms maintained an unyielding wall between foreign residents and permanent status. Expatriates entered on strict work permits, tied entirely to their employers, and departed the moment their contracts expired.Today, Ronaldo operates in an entirely different reality. He owns a piece of the kingdom. Without holding a Saudi passport, the Portuguese icon has secured the right to buy land, sponsor his family, and anchor his post-football life in the country. This unprecedented arrangement is made possible by a highly sophisticated legal instrument: Saudi Arabia’s Gifted Residency programme.From the Kingdom Suite to a Royal EnclaveRonaldo’s arrival on January 3, 2023, set a staggering benchmark for luxury. He and his extensive entourage initially commandeered 17 suites at the Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh at Kingdom Centre. For a month, the family resided in the two-story Kingdom Suite, a sprawling 4,000-square-foot duplex suspended between the 48th and 50th floors, costing an estimated $300,000.However, a hotel, no matter how grand, is not a home. The family soon transitioned to an exclusive, heavily fortified residential compound in Riyadh’s Al Muhammadiyah district. This estate serves as their principal base and comes as a phenomenal, club-provided perk. Al-Nassr handles the estate completely, funding a dedicated 16-person staff that operates like a boutique luxury hotel. The operation includes three drivers, four housemaids, two private chefs, three gardeners, and four security guards protecting the family 24/7. To supplement his life in the capital, the club also provided Ronaldo with a private jet valued at €4.5 million, covering all operational costs.Following his contract extension in June 2025, which binds him to Al-Nassr until 2027, and his marriage to Georgina Rodríguez in a private civil ceremony in Portugal on August 11, 2026, Riyadh has cemented itself as the family's geographic anchor.Unlocking the "Gifted Residency"While Al-Nassr provides his palatial Riyadh compound, Ronaldo’s long-term legal security rests on theSaudi Premium Residency programme. First introduced in 2019 under Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman’s Vision 2030 framework, the initiative was significantly expanded in January 2024 to include specialized tracks. Among these, the Gifted Residency was designed explicitly for elite international talent, athletes, and cultural pioneers.The government rolled out these pathways with explicit macro-economic goals: driving economic diversification away from oil dependency, accelerating the growth of the local sports and tourism sectors, and positioning the kingdom as a global hub that directly attracts and integrates world-class elite talent, innovators, and cultural pioneers into the country's long-term future.Under normal circumstances, foreign players in the Saudi Pro League receive a standard athlete work visa. This traditional route leaves them legally dependent on their club as a Kafeel (employer sponsor). If a player is transferred, retired, or dropped, their visa is voided, and they must exit the country or find a new employer.The Gifted Residency completely flips this dynamic. Endorsed directly by the Ministry of Sports, Ronaldo’s residency functions entirely independent of Al-Nassr. It grants a distinct set of structural privileges:Sponsorship Freedom: Absolute independence from an employer sponsor, allowing him to stay in the country even if he ceases playing football.Long-Term Permanence: A framework renewable every five years, matching his public desire to remain a part of the kingdom’s future over the long term.Family Stability: Complete rights to sponsor family members, including parents and children up to the age of 25, completely exempt from the standard expatriate dependent levies.Frictionless Logistics: Seamless, visa-free travel in and out of the country, complete with access to the expedited airport immigration lanes typically reserved for Saudi and GCC citizens.The Nujuma purchase: Buying into the Red SeaThe most profound benefit of the Gifted Residency is the absolute right to own freehold real estate. Ronaldo put this mechanism into action by looking beyond the capital to the pristine sands of the Red Sea coast, acquiring two ultra-luxury villas at Nujuma, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve.Reported at an estimated combined cost of £7 million ($9 million), the purchase establishes Ronaldo and Georgina as some of the very first individual owners within the hyper-exclusive Red Sea Residences community. The development features just 19 standalone, ocean-ring-shaped villas situated on private islands roughly 26 kilometres from the mainland. The estate is accessible exclusively via chartered boat or seaplane.Crucially, the sheer scale of this transactional value highlights a fascinating crossover in Saudi immigration law. Even if Cristiano Ronaldo were not a famed global footballing superstar, this purchase alone would have automatically granted him a Premium Residency. Under the program's official Real Estate Owner pathway, any foreign national who acquires developed, unmortgaged residential property valued at SAR 4 million (approximately $1.07 million USD) or more is legally entitled to long-term residency privileges. By spending $9 million, Ronaldo cleared this statutory benchmark nearly nine times over. Had he entered the country as an anonymous, ultra-high-net-worth investor rather than the world's most recognizable athlete, the doors of the Premium Residency Center would have swung open just as wide.The couple acquired a three-bedroom villa designed for primary family use alongside a separate two-bedroom villa. The island features world-class amenities including the Neyrah Spa, the Galaxea Diving Center, and a dedicated Conservation House. Reflecting on the sanctuary, Ronaldo shared his experience in verbatim terms reported by the Saudi Gazette:"Truly exceptional in every sense of the word. From our very first visit, Georgina and I felt a deep connection with this island and its breathtaking natural beauty. It’s a place where we find peace and tranquility."A tale of two visas: Saudi Arabia and the UAERonaldo’s property footprint is part of a broader, dual-pronged strategy in the Gulf. In February 2020, he was awarded the UAE Golden Visa by the Dubai Sports Council. Granted under the "elite talent" and "sports creators" category, the 10-year residency allowed him to bypass traditional property investment thresholds entirely based on his sporting prestige. As part of that inaugural cohort alongside stars like Novak Djokovic, the UAE utilized Ronaldo to pioneer its own specialized talent track.He would later leverage this long-term legal security to expand his regional footprint into premium Dubai real estate, reportedly purchasing a luxury waterfront property on Jumeirah Bay Island in 2024 for an estimated €25 million to €30 million—though that landmark transaction came years after his Golden Visa was initially awarded.The Saudi Gifted Residency operates on a parallel plane but offers a tailored level of local authority. John Pagano, CEO of Red Sea International, noted that Ronaldo's entry into the Red Sea community highlights a shared ethos. The entire destination operates on radical environmental goals, aiming for a 30% net positive ecological impact by 2040. Powered entirely by renewable energy, the community sits within three hours of 250 million people via the new Red Sea International Airport.Through the intersection of sports diplomacy and legislative reform, Saudi Arabia has given its premier football icon something far more valuable than a record-breaking salary: a permanent, sovereign stake in the kingdom's future.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Terzic: "Esperamos construir a partir de este partido y de esta victoria"
articles.standfirst: El entrenador reconoce que de no mediar la lesión de Galarreta habría sido un día redondo
articles.summary: El entrenador reconoce que de no mediar la lesión de Galarreta habría sido un día redondo
articles.body: El Athletic ganó con rotundidad al Getafe en un partido con dedicatoria para Guruzeta, lesionado de gravedad el pasado fin de semana frente al Valencia, y con impulso para Lezama tras los debuts de Imga y Txus Vizcay. El resultado colmó a Terzic. "Siempre es bueno ganar, más especialmente en casa. Ha sido merecido. También es importante marcar a balón parado. Esperamos construir a partir de esto", dijo. Sensación de final: "Era un partido que debíamos ganar, pero que queríamos ganar. Y lo teníamos que demostrar. Ha habido muchos buenos momentos, especialmente el cómo lo hemos empezado. Ha habido buenas actuaciones de muchos jugadores. Nico era casi imparable en su banda, Iñaki ha marcado por vez primera en la Liga, han debutado dos chicos de Lezama, ha vuelto Prados después de una lesión similar a la de Guruzeta, al que hemos recordado. El trabajo ahora es conseguir confianza para pasarla a los siguientes partidos". Los debutantes: "Hicimos el cambio de Imga cuando íbamos 2-0 y era un buen periodo. Luego entró Txus Vizcay y estuvo implicado en el tercer gol. No han sido regalos. Merecen esta oportunidad. Son pequeñas historias individuales. De no haber habido la molestia muscular de Galarreta habría sido redondo". Iñaki y Maroan: "Pueden jugar juntos. Y era una opción que queríamos tener también para afrontar un cambio posible del sistema de nuestro oponente. Han hecho buen partido, igual que Vivian, que ha estado muy bien en su primeros minutos de la temporada". Puntos de tranquilidad: "Los tres puntos siempre son buenos. Me gusta ganar hasta en los entrenamientos. Soy el más decepcionado de las últimas semanas por no ganar, pero mi trabajo es controlar las emociones del equipo y también tengo que controlar las mías tras ganar hoy. Tengo mucha confianza en el equipo".

articles.title: Baylor fires head coach Dave Aranda, Joe Klanderman to serve as interim
articles.summary: Aranda tallied a 40-40 record over seven seasons.
articles.body:
The Baylor Bears have fired head football coach Dave Aranda, the school announced on Sunday. Defensive coordinator Joe Klanderman will serve as interim head coach for the rest of the regular season.

Baylor hired Aranda ahead of the 2020 season. It was his first time as head coach, and he came from LSU after serving as assistant head coach and defensive coordinator for four years, including on the Tigers' national championship-winning squad in 2019.

The Bears went 2-7 in the COVID-19-shortened season in Aranda's first year, but bounced back in a big way, going 12-2 in 2021, including a Sugar Bowl win. It remains the most single-season wins in school history.

Aranda couldn't sustain that success, as the Bears went 6-7 and 3-9 over the next two seasons. Baylor has been to just three bowl games in the past six years and lost two. Aranda leaves Baylor with a 40-40 record.

The Bears started this season 4-1 but lost to TCU two weeks ago. Then Baylor lost this weekend to Kansas, as the Jayhawks scored the game-winning touchdown with just 1:13 left.

This loss dropped the Bears to 4-3 overall and 2-2 in the Big 12.

Aranda becomes the third FBS head coach fired this season. Maryland was the first program to fire their head coach, cutting ties with Mike Locksley , and then NC State fired Dave Doeren on Saturday.

This is Klanderman's first season at Baylor. He spent the past seven seasons at Kansas State as safeties coach and then defensive coordinator. Klanderman has never been a head coach, and how he fares over Baylor's remaining five games will dictate if he is considered for the opening this offseason.

The Bears will go on the road to face UCF this coming Friday. Then, Baylor ends the season against Iowa State, BYU, Texas Tech and Houston. The Bears need to win at least two of those games to become bowl-eligible.

articles.title: ‘I kind of like being disregarded’: Arch Manning sends a message to his critics
articles.summary: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning has spent his entire football life as one of the most hyped players in the sport, from his days as a top recruit to...
articles.body:
Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning has spent his entire football life as one of the most hyped players in the sport, from his days as a top recruit to entering this season as a Heisman Trophy favorite. But after back-to-back losses to Oklahoma and Florida, he found himself in an unfamiliar spot this week, with talk swirling that he could lose his starting job.

Manning responded by scoring the go-ahead touchdown in Saturday night's 34-27 win over No. 7 Ole Miss. And afterward, he admitted that he has actually enjoyed being doubted for a change, saying he actually kind of likes "being disregarded."

Texas lost to Oklahoma and Florida by identical 27-24 scores, and Manning was at the center of both. He threw two fourth-quarter interceptions against the Sooners, then fumbled on Texas' final drive against the Gators with the Longhorns near midfield and less than two minutes left.

After the Florida loss, head coach Steve Sarkisian said that "everything is going to be evaluated" as he didn't rule out the possibility of making a quarterback. This led to backup KJ Lacey Jr. seeing a big increase in first-team reps as Texas began preparing for a potential change . Sarkisian also reportedly warned Manning that he would make a change unless he performed better.

Needless to say, the pressure took its toll. Manning said that he went to his parents' house the day after the loss to Florida.

"It was a hard Sunday, I went over to their place and damn near bawled, cried to them," Manning said, via Yahoo Sports .

On Saturday, Manning played nearly the entire game, exiting for just one play for a mandatory medical check. Texas jumped out to a 24-3 halftime lead, blew it, and then held on after Manning ran in the go-ahead touchdown in the fourth quarter.

After the game, Manning said he had embraced being in a different position.

"I've been hyped up all my life, preseason and all that stuff," Manning said. "I think I kind of like being disregarded."

Still, it wasn't a perfect night. Manning turned the ball over three times, throwing two interceptions and losing a fumble on Texas' first possession of the second half.

To make matters worse, Texas lost star left tackle Trevor Goosby to a leg injury in the first half, and he had to be carted off the field. Wide receiver Cam Coleman also left with a shoulder injury in the second half. Sarkisian didn't have an update on either player, but said neither "looked very good."

The win keeps Texas at 5-2, and a loss would have put the Longhorns on the brink of missing the College Football Playoff for the second straight season. They're now one of eight SEC teams with two conference losses.

Needless to say, it's good that Manning enjoys the pressure, because the Longhorns are probably going to be feelin it the rest of the season, too.

articles.title: Man Utd battered by Bournemouth to leave Carrick on the brink
articles.summary: Manchester United slumped further into crisis with a 3-0 home defeat to Bournemouth on Sunday that plunged Michael Carrick's future as manager into doubt.But...
articles.body:
Manchester United slumped further into crisis with a 3-0 home defeat to Bournemouth on Sunday that plunged Michael Carrick's future as manager into doubt.

Carrick's bold decision to drop captain Bruno Fernandes backfired as defeat stretched United's winless run to eight games and left them 16th in the Premier League, just one point above the relegation zone.

For the third time in four seasons, the Cherries won 3-0 at Old Trafford as goals from Rayan, Marcus Tavernier and Evanilson secured a fully deserved win for Marco Rose's side.

Fernandes was critical of Carrick's tactics in a 4-1 thrashing by Champions League debutants Como on Wednesday.

The United boss said the decision to leave out last season's Premier League player of the year was a "purely football" driven, but it was hard to believe Fernandes was not being punished as he was left on the bench for the entire match.

Carrick was taunted with chants of "you're getting sacked in the morning" from the Bournemouth fans.

But on this evidence, dismissing another manager is far from a quick fix for a club that has fallen dramatically from grace since Alex Ferguson's retirement 13 years ago.

A strong finish to last season during Carrick's interim spell in charge secured third place in the Premier League, but was aided by a lack of European or domestic cup football.

United have won just twice -- against newly-promoted Ipswich and Azerbaijani side Sabah -- in 12 games in all competitions this season.

Bournemouth began the day behind the Red Devils in the table after a difficult start for Rose.

But just three days after beating AC Milan 3-0, they outclassed another giant of the European game.

Rayan opened the floodgates when he connected sweetly with Justin Kluivert's free-kick on 38 minutes.

Five minutes later, Leny Yoro stumbled under pressure from Adrien Truffert and the French full-back had a simple task to square for Tavernier to tap into an empty net.

Many expected Fernandes to be stripped and ready for the start of the second half, but he remained on the bench and the United performance got no better.

Inside the first minute of the restart Evanilson found the net, but was flagged offside.

That let-off mattered little as Bournemouth could have run out even more convincing winners.

Senne Lammens denied Rayan before the Brazilian winger fired wide after racing past Lisandro Martinez.

Evanilson did finally add a third 20 minutes from time when he rounded Lammens before curling in an exquisite finish from a narrow angle.

The United support unleashed their fury at the club's unpopular owners, the Glazer family, rather than Carrick in the closing stages.

Carrick applauded the Stretford End and touched his chest as he made his way down the tunnel.

However, it is the manager who will likely be the fall guy after another miserable afternoon for the 20-time English champions.

articles.title: Alexander Isak Fires Liverpool to Huge Win Over Brighton
articles.summary: Liverpool 2-0 Brighton: Isak Fires Reds to Important Anfield VictoryLiverpool moved up to fourth in the Premier League table after securing a 2-0 victory ove...
articles.body:
Liverpool 2-0 Brighton: Isak Fires Reds to Important Anfield Victory

Liverpool moved up to fourth in the Premier League table after securing a 2-0 victory over Brighton at Anfield, with Alexander Isak finding the net and Pascal Groß scoring an unfortunate own goal in a decisive first half spell.

Andoni Iraola's side made the most of their opportunities against a Brighton team that arrived in strong form. The result delivered Liverpool their first home Premier League win of the season and kept them firmly in contention near the top of the table.

Brighton remain third despite the defeat, holding a one point advantage over Liverpool after suffering only their second loss in 13 matches across all competitions this season.

Liverpool Capitalise on Brighton's Missed Opportunity

Brighton started brightly and looked capable of troubling Liverpool during the opening exchanges. Yasin Ayari had an excellent opportunity to put the visitors ahead after a well worked attacking move, but his effort flew over the crossbar.

That miss proved costly as Liverpool gradually took control of the contest. The home side opened the scoring in the 17th minute when Florian Wirtz attempted to find the target, only for his effort to be diverted into the net by Groß.

The own goal ended Brighton's run of Premier League defensive resilience, with the Seagulls having last conceded in their 1-1 draw against Leeds on 5 September.

Liverpool seized the momentum and quickly established a two goal cushion, leaving Brighton with an uphill task at Anfield.

Liverpool doubled their lead in the 21st minute through Isak, who finished an excellent attacking move to put the hosts in a commanding position.

Bradley Barcola supplied the decisive contribution, beating his opponent down the right wing before delivering a cross into the penalty area. Isak connected with a composed volley, directing the ball beyond the Brighton goalkeeper to make it 2-0.

The strike marked Isak's third consecutive Premier League appearance with a goal, highlighting his importance to Liverpool's attacking plans. His movement and finishing gave the Reds the clinical edge needed to turn their early pressure into a substantial advantage.

Barcola also deserved credit for his role in the goal, providing the pace and creativity that Brighton struggled to contain during Liverpool's productive spell.

For Iraola, the four minute period in which Liverpool scored twice demonstrated the value of converting promising attacking situations into goals.

Despite trailing by two goals, Brighton continued to search for a response and were given a significant opportunity when Alisson made an error while playing out from the back.

Ayari capitalised on the loose possession and attempted to punish Liverpool, but his shot struck the foot of the right hand post. It was a major escape for the home side, with Brighton coming close to reducing the deficit and changing the complexion of the match.

Liverpool remained organised after that scare, protecting their advantage and preventing the visitors from building enough pressure to mount a comeback.

The victory continued Iraola's positive start at Anfield, following two home Champions League wins and a Carabao Cup victory.

Liverpool Gain Ground in Premier League Race

Liverpool's 2-0 success provides an important boost as they look to establish consistency in the Premier League. Moving from fifth to fourth, the Reds are now just one point behind Brighton.

The performance combined clinical finishing with the composure required to manage difficult moments, particularly after Alisson's costly lapse nearly offered the visitors a route back into the contest.

Brighton will be disappointed to leave Anfield empty handed after their promising start, but their position in third reflects an otherwise productive campaign.

For Liverpool, Isak's continued scoring form and Barcola's creative influence offer encouraging signs as Iraola looks to build momentum. Three points against a direct rival could prove valuable as the Premier League season develops.

articles.title: Isak scores again as Liverpool beat Brighton
articles.summary: Liverpool record their first home Premier League win of the season thanks to an impressive victory over in-form Brighton, with Alexander Isak in the goals ag...
articles.body:
Liverpool 2 - 0 Brighton & Hove Albion FT

Liverpool recorded their first home Premier League win of the season thanks to an impressive performance against in-form Brighton.

Two goals in a four-minute first half spell - an own goal from Seagulls midfielder Pascal Gross followed by Alexander Isak's sixth goal of the season - put the Reds in control.

They should have conceded before the goals came, but Brighton's Yasin Ayari fired wastefully over the top after a fine move from the visitors.

Ayari's miss proved costly as Liverpool took a 17th-minute lead when Florian Wirtz's shot, which was going wide, was diverted into his own net by the unfortunate Gross.

That was the first goal the Seagulls had conceded in the league since a 1-1 draw against Leeds on 5 September.

Brighton's defence was breached again shortly after, when Bradley Barcola did superbly down the right wing to create a chance and his cross was met by Isak's cushioned volley to double the Reds' advantage.

The visitors were nearly gifted a way back into the match when home goalkeeper Alisson lost possession when playing out for the back, but Ayari's shot rebounded off the foot of the right-hand post.

Liverpool saw out Andoni Iraola's first league win at Anfield as Reds boss - to follow two home Champions League victories and one in the Carabao Cup since he replaced the sacked Arne Slot in the summer.

Brighton's loss was only their second in 13 matches in all competitions in 2026-27 and they stayed third in the Premier League, with Liverpool moving up from fifth to fourth, one point behind the Seagulls.

Liverpool analysis: Iraola's side finding rhythm

Iraola's side are starting to find form, with this their fourth successive victory since a 3-0 loss to Manchester City in their previous Premier League match at Anfield.

Since that defeat, the Reds have now scored 14 goals in four games, with big-name players showing their class in the Premier League and Champions League.

Midfielder Wirtz has seen his performances come under huge scrutiny and debate since his move from Bayer Leverkusen in June 2025 in a deal that could rise to £116m.

The German, impressive on this occasion before going off in the 65th minute, thought he had scored his first Premier League goal of the season.

He was originally credited with Liverpool's opener, only for it to be later judged as a Gross own goal.

Barcola and Isak, who also each cost more than £100m, linked up superbly for Liverpool's second goal with the Reds a constant threat on the counter-attack.

Isak joined in a British record £125m move from Newcastle in September 2025, but he missed a large part of last season with a broken leg.

But the Swede's total of six league goals this season is the second highest in the Premier League this season, behind only Manchester City's Erling Haaland on nine.

Liverpool could and should have scored more.

Brighton goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen twice saved to deny Cody Gakpo and also kept out an effort from Ronald Araujo. Ex-Seagulls midfielder Alexis Mac Allister headed wide against his former side and Isak fired another attempt over.

At the other end of the pitch, the Reds' defensive performances have been questioned this season, but they produced a resilient effort in the second half to stop any potential Brighton fightback.

articles.title: Filipe Luís resiste a la lesión de Ansu y frustra a Davide
articles.standfirst: El Mónaco aprovechó la expulsión de Nianzou para igualar el choque ante el Lille tras el gol de Ethan Mbappé en la primera parte
articles.summary: El Mónaco aprovechó la expulsión de Nianzou para igualar el choque ante el Lille tras el gol de Ethan Mbappé en la primera parte
articles.body: Filipe Luís y Davide Ancelotti son dos de los entrenadores más prometedores que militan actualmente en la Ligue 1. Su primer enfrentamiento, sin embargo, se saldó con unas tablas en El Principado... que le saben mejor al ex de Flamengo que al hijo de Carlo. El encuentro no pudo arrancar peor para el Mónaco. Y es que, justo al cumplirse el primer cuarto de hora de partido, Ansu Fati levantó la mano y pidió el cambio tras sentir un 'pinchazo' en la parte posterior del muslo. Ausente durante las primeras semanas de temporada, apenas ha podido enlazar cuatro partidos en los que, eso sí, ha registrado dos goles. Supuso, desde luego, un duro golpe para un Mónaco que, menos de 10' después, encajó el 0-1. El Lille recuperó alto y Diaoune, que venía de marcar un doblete contra el Galatasaray en Champions, filtró un balón para la llegada desde segunda línea de Ethan Mbappé. Resolvió de primeras abriendo el pie para ajustar su remate al palo largo y celebrar su segundo gol de la temporada. Filipe Luís movió ficha al descanso y dio entrada a Abline y Ethan Diop. Le cambió la cara por completo al Mónaco y, después de que Paris Brunner perdonase en boca de gol, el delantero alemán recibió una dura entrada por parte de un Tanguy Nianzou que vio la roja directa en el 66'. El Lille quedó tocado y, a un cuarto de hora para el final, Ethan Diop metió un centro 'envenenado' que no llegó a conectar Paris Brunner... pero que engañó lo suficiente a Özer para acabar dentro de la portería. Reparto de puntos que sitúa a ambos conjuntos al frente de la clasificación con 15 puntos... a la espera que lo que suceda en el PSG-Lyon aplazado para mañana.
